title: Shortcut Sensitivity in Agent-Safety Evaluations
title_zh: AI智能体安全性评估中的捷径敏感性

paragraphs.en: TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
paragraphs.zh: TAE（信任-人工智能评估）：我们能信任人工智能的评估吗？

paragraphs.en: AI agents take actions through tools. Some actions are sensitive, so guards that supervise them must themselves be evaluated reliably. Yet the data used to evaluate a guard can include cues that make labels predictable without measuring the intended safety construct, and those cues can also influence guard decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能智能体通过工具执行操作。 某些操作具有敏感性，因此监督这些操作的守卫本身也必须经过可靠的评估。 然而，用于评估守卫的数据可能包含一些线索，这些线索使得标签无需测量预期的安全结构即可被预测，而这些线索也可能影响守卫的决策。

sents.en: Yet the data used to evaluate a guard can include cues that make labels predictable without measuring the intended safety construct, and those cues can also influence guard decisions.
sents.zh: 然而，用于评估守卫的数据可能包含一些线索，这些线索使得标签无需测量预期的安全结构即可被预测，而这些线索也可能影响守卫的决策。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a three-level shortcut-auditing framework and audit completed LinuxArena trajectories and two TS-Bench -derived step datasets. We distinguish label predictability, observational guard association, and paired decision sensitivity. In LinuxArena , shorter average shell commands strongly predict trajectory labels. In AgentDojo-Traj , exact-tool lookup falls from F 1 = .901 F_{1}=.901 with mixed-domain folds to .495 .495 under domain holdout. In AgentHarm-Traj , released TS-Guard F 1 F_{1} falls from .902 .902 under row weighting to .719 .719 with equal interaction weighting, while balanced accuracy rises.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种三级快捷审计框架，并对已完成的 LinuxArena 轨迹以及两个源自 TS-Bench 的步骤数据集进行了审计。 我们区分了标签可预测性、观察性防护关联以及成对决策敏感性。 在 LinuxArena 中，较短的平均 shell 命令能够强有力地预测轨迹标签。 在 AgentDojo-Traj 中，精确工具查找的 F1 值从混合域折叠时的 F_{1}=.901 下降至领域保留测试下的 .495。 在 AgentHarm-Traj 中，已发布的 TS-Guard 的 F1 值在行加权下从 .902 下降至等交互加权下的 .719，而平衡准确率则有所上升。

sents.en: In AgentHarm-Traj , released TS-Guard F 1 F_{1} falls from .902 .902 under row weighting to .719 .719 with equal interaction weighting, while balanced accuracy rises.

paragraphs.en: We then test the strongest safe-row marker association in a seven-configuration screen on a frozen 64-step AgentDojo-Traj cohort using repeated, interleaved Haiku calls. Rewriting the <INFORMATION> marker lowers blocking by 8.33 8.33 percentage points, while opaque tool aliases raise it by 11.46 11.46 points. All unsafe calls remain blocked; the changes concern false positives against inherited labels. Both effects remain nonzero after subtracting the formatting-placebo effect, with exploratory 95% ranges excluding zero. The same edits also change measured accuracy against inherited labels. This provides direct evidence that benchmark representation can materially change a guard’s decisions and measured evaluation performance. The Haiku-sized effects do not reproduce in Luna or deterministic Q8 TS-Guard . We recommend domain group holdouts, evaluation-unit metrics, and placebo-controlled paired interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们使用重复交错执行的 Haiku 调用，在冻结的 64 步 AgentDojo-Traj 数据集上，通过一个包含七种配置的屏幕测试了最强安全行标记关联。 重写 <INFORMATION> 标记可将阻塞率降低 8.33 个百分点，而不透明的工具别名则会使阻塞率上升 11.46 个百分点。 所有不安全调用仍被阻止；这些变化涉及对继承标签的误判。 在减去格式占位效应后，这两种影响仍然不为零，且探索性 95% 置信区间均不包含零。 同样的修改也改变了与继承标签相关的测量准确率。 这直接证明了基准表示方式可能会实质性改变守护机制的决策及其测量评估表现。 这种 Haiku 规模的影响在 Luna 或确定性 Q8 TS-Guard 中并未重现。 我们建议采用领域分组留样、评估单元指标以及安慰剂对照的配对干预方法。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark may be easy for the wrong reason. Annotation conventions, source identity, repeated templates, and collection artifacts can all predict labels without measuring the intended construct ( Gururangan et al., 2018 ; Geirhos et al., 2020 ) . This problem is especially consequential for agent-safety evaluation. A tool guard may be deployed to approve or block a consequential action, while its benchmark record also contains scaffolding added by the evaluation pipeline: provenance tags, tool names, trajectory length, source subsets, and repeated interaction structure.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试可能因错误的原因而显得简单。 标注规范、来源身份、重复模板和数据收集的人工痕迹，都可能在不衡量目标构建物的情况下预测标签（Gururangan 等，2018；Geirhos 等，2020）。 这个问题对智能体安全性评估尤其重要。 可以部署工具守卫来批准或阻止关键操作，而该工具的基准记录中也包含了评估流程添加的辅助信息：来源标签、工具名称、轨迹长度、来源子集以及重复交互结构。

paragraphs.en: Simple lexical and length features separated honest and attack trajectories in the public LinuxArena sample, motivating a search for analogous rules elsewhere. Such a rule may track real risk, collection differences, or evidence also used by a capable guard; rule–guard agreement cannot distinguish these explanations.
paragraphs.zh: 在公开的 LinuxArena 样本中，简单的词汇和长度特征能够区分出诚实轨迹与攻击轨迹，这促使人们在其他地方寻找类似的规则。 这样的规则可能追踪到真实风险、收集差异，或是有能力的守卫也会使用的证据；规则与守卫之间的一致性无法区分这些解释。

paragraphs.en: To systematically uncover potential shortcuts, we introduce shortcut auditing as a three-level inference ladder for agent-safety guard evaluations. A shortcut audit asks progressively stronger questions: can a simple cue predict released labels; is that cue associated with guard decisions; and does changing only that cue alter the guard’s decision?
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统地揭示潜在的捷径，我们将捷径审计引入智能体安全守卫评估中，作为三级推理阶梯。 捷径审计会提出逐步更强的问题：一个简单的提示能否预测已释放的标签？该提示是否与守卫决策相关？仅改变该提示是否会改变守卫的决策？

sents.zh: 捷径审计会提出逐步更强的问题：一个简单的提示能否预测已释放的标签？该提示是否与守卫决策相关？仅改变该提示是否会改变守卫的决策？

paragraphs.en: Label Predictability : Can a deliberately capability-poor rule predict released labels?
paragraphs.zh: 标签可预测性：一个故意设计为能力较弱的规则能否预测已发布的标签？

paragraphs.en: Observational Guard Association : Do guard decisions correlate with the suspected cue in released records?
paragraphs.zh: 观察守卫协会：守卫决策是否与已发布记录中推测的线索相关？

paragraphs.en: Paired Decision Sensitivity : Does the guard change when the cue is changed while the candidate action’s authorization and effect are held fixed?
paragraphs.zh: 成对决策敏感性：在候选行动的授权和效果保持不变的情况下，当提示改变时，守卫是否会改变？

paragraphs.en: Paired edits test whether changing the input changes the guard’s decision. To interpret that change as spurious shortcut reliance, the edits must preserve the relevant safety information. For a deterministic guard, evaluating each original–edited pair reveals whether the strict decision changes. Stochastic guards require additional controls because identical inputs can produce different outputs and sequential calls may drift over time. We therefore interleave repeated original and edited calls, include a formatting placebo, and report identical-input disagreement separately.
paragraphs.zh: 成对编辑用于测试输入的变化是否会导致守卫的决策发生变化。 要将这种变化解释为对捷径的虚假依赖，这些编辑必须保留相关的安全信息。 对于确定性守卫，评估每一组原始输入与编辑后的输入，即可发现严格决策是否发生变化。 随机性守卫需要额外的控制措施，因为相同的输入可能产生不同的输出，而连续调用可能会随时间发生偏移。 因此，我们将重复的原始调用和编辑后的调用交错进行，加入格式化的安慰剂，并单独报告相同输入下的不一致情况。

paragraphs.en: Guard-level shortcut validation. We move beyond showing that benchmark labels are predictable by testing candidate cues directly against guard decisions, using a purpose-built TS-Guard reproduction and hosted models configured as pre-execution guards. Repeated paired AgentDojo-Traj interventions with a placebo control reveal material Haiku sensitivity, while Luna and Q8 TS-Guard checks show that the effect is configuration-specific. Haiku blocking changes by − 8.33 -8.33 percentage points (pp) for the marker rewrite and + 11.46 ​ pp +11.46\,\mathrm{pp} for aliases. With the same cohort, conditions, schedule, repetitions, and estimand, GPT-5.6 Luna gives 0.00 ​ pp 0.00\,\mathrm{pp} and + 1.04 ​ pp +1.04\,\mathrm{pp} , while the deterministic TS-Guard reproduction changes its decision for 3 of 64 marker-edit pairs.

paragraphs.en: The result is deliberately not “these benchmarks are broken.” Some proxies are intentional and semantically relevant: an untrusted-content marker communicates provenance, and a malicious request is relevant to a harm policy. Our claim is that such features create shortcut opportunities . Evaluation authors should measure whether conclusions survive group holdouts, equal-unit weighting, paired perturbations with construct-preservation caveats, and repeat-original controls. paragraphs.en: LinuxArena evaluates control protocols for agents operating in live software environments ( Tracy et al., 2026 ) . We use the 932-row public sample at a pinned dataset revision. Of these, 918 rows contain extracted shell commands. Because the public sample repeats action traces under different monitor runs, we hash complete action content after removing only the monitor response. The primary diagnostic contains 576 exact-action-unique shell trajectories: 176 attack and 400 honest across ten environments. We never use the nominally unique trajectory_id as a deduplication key. The sample also contains LinuxArena’s precomputed per-action suspicion scores from its Claude Opus 4.6 monitor on 200 Opus-generated honest trajectories and 74 human-crafted LaStraj attacks. The monitor conditions on the task, possible side-task goals, and tool-call history, but not agent reasoning; each stored score averages two calls.
paragraphs.zh: LinuxArena 评估智能体在实时软件环境中运行的控制协议（Tracy 等，2026）。 我们使用固定数据集版本中 932 行的公开样本。 其中，918 行包含提取的 shell 命令。 由于公开样本在不同监控运行中重复了动作轨迹，我们在仅移除监控响应的情况下对完整的动作内容进行了哈希处理。 主要诊断数据包含 576 条完全独特的动作 shell 轨迹：十个环境中包含 176 条攻击轨迹和 400 条诚实轨迹。 我们从未将名义上唯一的 trajectory_id 用作去重键。 该样本还包含 LinuxArena 预先计算出的每个动作的怀疑分数，这些数据来自其 Claude Opus 4.6 监控器对 200 条由 Opus 生成的诚实轨迹和 74 条人工设计的 LaStraj 攻击的评估。 监控器的条件取决于任务、可能的子任务目标以及工具调用历史，但不包括智能体的推理过程；每个存储的分数是两次调用的平均值。

paragraphs.en: ToolSafe introduces TS-Bench and TS-Guard for pre-execution, step-level tool safety ( Mou et al., 2026 ) . We use these files at a pinned commit; the paired AgentDojo-Traj variants described below are the only new inputs we construct. Under ToolSafe’s strict mapping, every nonzero risk rating is unsafe. paragraphs.en: Here, an audit means applying the three-level framework in Section 2 to released evaluation artifacts. We test whether simple cues predict labels, whether input-visible cues are associated with guard decisions, and, when an edit intended to preserve the construct is available, whether paired edits change those decisions. The analysis is black-box: it uses released records, outputs, and fixed input transformations without access to guard internals. We do not test an adaptive agent, an evasion attack, or end-to-end tool execution.

paragraphs.en: Level 1 begins with one deliberately limited diagnostic matched to each artifact’s construction. The aim is not to build the best classifier. It is to test whether a narrow cue recovers released labels and whether that result survives controls for duplication, source overlap, transfer, and evaluation-unit weighting. For LinuxArena, the deterministic score is the negative mean shell-command character count, so larger scores indicate shorter commands. We compare it with character n n -gram TF–IDF and logistic regression trained leave-one-environment-out (LOEO). We report AUC and a clustered bootstrap over main-task/side-task groups. These are completed-trajectory diagnostics, not operational step-wise monitors.

paragraphs.en: For AgentDojo-Traj, the fixed binary rule requires both the literal <INFORMATION> marker in history and a current tool whose name starts with one of 11 side-effect verbs (for example, send_ , delete_ , or update_ ). The rule and verb list were frozen after initial inspection, so this is a diagnostic audit rather than a preregistered test. A second diagnostic memorizes each exact tool’s majority label. For unseen tool names, it predicts the training fold’s overall majority label; ties are classified as unsafe. We evaluate it both with interaction- grouped five-fold cross-validation and leave-one-domain-out (LODO) transfer. The lookup explicitly uses evaluation labels and must not be described as a deployable classifier.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 AgentDojo-Traj，固定的二进制规则要求历史记录中必须包含字面标记 <INFORMATION>，并且当前使用的工具名称必须以 11 个副作用动词之一开头（例如 send_、delete_ 或 update_）。 该规则和动词列表在初步检查后已固定不变，因此这是一项诊断性审核，而非预先注册的测试。 第二个诊断模型会记住每个具体工具的多数标签。 对于未见过的工具名称，它会预测训练数据集中整体的多数标签；若出现平局，则归类为不安全。 我们使用交互分组的五折交叉验证以及“留一域出”（LODO）迁移方法对其进行评估。 该查找过程明确使用了评估标签，且不得被描述为可部署的分类器。

paragraphs.en: For AgentHarm-Traj, we test the all-unsafe baseline and audit the mapping from source subset to strict label. We then recompute guard metrics at three units: rows, equal-weight interactions, and one majority prediction per interaction. This distinguishes performance over recorded steps from performance over underlying tasks. Separately, we case-fold parsed tool names, normalize their structured arguments, retain exact-execution groups containing both labels, and compare safe and unsafe context means with equal weight per execution group.

paragraphs.en: A frozen cohort is a fixed panel of base steps and paired edits selected before any guard is run on the edited inputs. Freezing prevents us from choosing examples after seeing intervention outcomes; pairing holds the underlying step fixed; and balancing eight marker-present safe and eight marker-present unsafe steps from each AgentDojo domain prevents one domain or label from dominating. This deterministic selection produces 64 bases from 58 source interactions. “Frozen” does not mean preregistered or representative of the full benchmark: released labels and earlier guard outputs had already been inspected. Each base has an original; a marker rewrite replacing <INFORMATION> with <UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL_CONTENT> (and the matching closing tag) while retaining enclosed content; a consistent opaque tool alias retaining description and arguments; and their combination. The hosted run adds a neutral placebo that changes only outer JSON whitespace. Operational-action and label preservation were intended edit constraints, not independently established facts: we performed no blinded human equivalence check. The marker rewrite makes untrusted external provenance more explicit, while the aliases are generated separately for each sample and do not represent one globally consistent tool renaming, so the estimand is sensitivity to these exact edits rather than proof of spurious use. Within this study, marker rewrite versus original is the focal edit; alias and combined edits are exploratory stress tests.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Claude Haiku 4.5 ( Anthropic, 2025 ) as a prompted stochastic guard. In a seven-configuration observational screen, it had the largest safe-row marker association ( 74.09 ​ pp 74.09\,\mathrm{pp} ), making it a high-association case for paired intervention. Selection used cached observational outputs; the 64-step cohort and edits were fixed before the 960 new intervention calls. Table 3 reports the full screen. We make three deterministically interleaved calls per base and condition (960 total), at temperature zero with structured outputs, routing only to Anthropic through OpenRouter with fallback disabled. The primary estimand averages each base’s three-call block-probability difference, with 10,000 domain-stratified bootstrap replicates clustered over the 58 source interactions. The formatting placebo and within-condition disagreement diagnose serialization sensitivity and instability. After the Haiku result, but before inspecting any valid Luna outcome, we added GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as a compact cross-provider replication. It uses the same cohort, prompt, five conditions, three calls per condition, and normalized base/condition/repetition order. We route only to OpenAI through OpenRouter with fallback disabled, request medium reasoning and structured output, and apply the same estimand and bootstrap. This replication tests cross-model generality; it is not a model-strength comparison. A secondary one-draw GPT-5.5 check is reported in Appendix C ; it is not part of the repeated primary analysis.

paragraphs.en: The length result uses negative mean shell-command characters, not a hard cutoff. paragraphs.en: AgentDojo attack templates wrap injected external content in the literal <INFORMATION>... </INFORMATION> tag pair; we call this pair the marker. The strict label applies to the candidate current action, not the enclosed text. All 352 strict-unsafe rows contain the marker, as do 321 of 868 safe rows. The marker alone has perfect recall but a 37.0 % 37.0\% false-positive rate ( F 1 = .687 F_{1}=.687 ). Adding the short action-prefix list yields the stronger fixed rule in Table 1 . Separately, 40 of 51 exact tool names are label-pure and cover 776 rows. This explains the high grouped-CV lookup score, while its LODO collapse shows that the mapping is domain-specific. Appendix D reports lookup performance separately for tool names seen and unseen in the training domains.
paragraphs.zh: AgentDojo 攻击模板将注入的外部内容包裹在字面量 <INFORMATION>... </INFORMATION> 标签对中；我们将这对标签称为标记。 严格标签适用于候选当前动作，而非其内部包含的文本。 所有 352 个严格不安全行均包含该标记，868 个安全行中也有 321 行包含该标记。 仅凭该标记可实现完美的召回率，但假阳性率为 37.0%（F₁ = .687）。 加入简短的动作前缀列表后，可得到表 1 中更强大的固定规则。 此外，在 51 个精确工具名中，有 40 个是标签纯净的，并覆盖了 776 行数据。 这解释了分组交叉验证查找得分较高的原因，而 LODO 崩溃现象则表明该映射具有领域特异性。 附录 D 分别报告了在训练领域中见过和未见过工具名的查找性能。

paragraphs.en: For AgentHarm-Traj, the released source subset determines all 731 strict labels: every harmful_steps row is strict-unsafe and every benign_steps row is strict-safe. This metadata is not necessarily shown to a guard, so it is a composition diagnostic rather than an input-visible shortcut. It nevertheless exposes a metric sensitivity. The 72 harmful interactions contribute 7.29 rows on average, versus 1.65 for 125 benign interactions. Released TS-Guard’s row-level F 1 = .902 F_{1}=.902 falls to .719 .719 under equal-interaction weighting, while balanced accuracy changes from .754 .754 to .776 .776 (full table in the appendix). Thus the guard retains discrimination, but headline positive-class F 1 F_{1} answers a step-frequency-weighted question. Claims over tasks or interactions should report that unit alongside row-level performance.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 AgentHarm-Traj，已发布的源数据子集决定了全部 731 个严格标签：每一行 harmful_steps 均为严格不安全，而每一行 benign_steps 均为严格安全。 此类元数据未必会展示给守卫，因此它属于一种组合诊断，而非输入可见的快捷方式。 尽管如此，它仍然暴露了一种指标敏感性。 72 次有害交互平均贡献了 7.29 行，而 125 次良性交互的平均值为 1.65 行。 已发布的 TS-Guard 的行级 F1 值从 .902 F_{1}=.902 下降至 .719 .719（在交互次数均等加权的情况下），而平衡准确率则从 .754 .754 变为 .776 .776（完整表格见附录）。 因此，守卫仍然具备区分能力，但作为主要结果的阳性类别 F1 值 F_{1} 实际上反映的是一个按步骤频率加权的指标。 关于任务或交互的声明应一并报告该单位与行级性能表现。

paragraphs.en: As a matched-context control, we group AgentHarm rows by case-folded parsed tool name and normalized arguments, retaining only groups containing both strict labels. The 16 mixed groups contain 69 rows from 39 interactions. Giving each execution group equal weight, released TS-Guard’s mean composite score is .922 .922 in unsafe contexts and .413 .413 in safe contexts (difference .510 .510 ): the unsafe mean is higher in 11 groups and tied in five, with no reversal. All six cached hosted guards also have a positive macro difference. Thus rows with the same normalized execution signature can receive different scores across the benchmark’s label/context groups; tool identity alone is insufficient to explain guard behavior. This fixed-benchmark matched analysis does not identify authorization context as the cause.
paragraphs.zh: 作为匹配上下文的对照，我们将 AgentHarm 的行按大小写折叠后的解析工具名称和标准化参数进行分组，仅保留同时包含严格标签的组。 这 16 个混合组包含来自 39 次交互的 69 行数据。 在给予每个执行组相等权重的情况下，TS-Guard 在不安全上下文中的平均综合得分为 .922 .922，在安全上下文中的平均综合得分为 .413 .413（差异为 .510 .510）：不安全上下文中的平均值在 11 个组中更高，在五个组中相同，从未出现逆转。 所有六个缓存的主机守卫也呈现出正的宏观差异。 因此，具有相同标准化执行签名的行在不同基准测试的标签/上下文组中可能会获得不同的分数；仅凭工具身份不足以解释守卫的行为。 这种固定基准的匹配分析并未将授权上下文确定为原因。

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest a minimum audit sequence for agent-safety evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，智能体安全性评估存在一个最小的审计序列。

paragraphs.en: Diagnose and stress transfer. Test capability-poor cues, then deduplicate the semantic unit and hold out environments, domains, templates, or sources. A strong result is a trigger, not a verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断与压力传递。 测试能力较弱的提示，然后对语义单元进行去重，并保留环境、领域、模板或来源。 强有力的结果是一个触发因素，而非最终判定。

paragraphs.en: A public rule can become an adaptive target, motivating hidden group holdouts and refreshed equivalent serializations ( Tramèr et al., 2020 ; Jotautaitė et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) ; we do not test such adaptation here.

paragraphs.en: Shortcut auditing connects annotation artifacts and shortcut learning ( Gururangan et al., 2018 ; Geirhos et al., 2020 ) to group-shift tests, contrast sets, behavioral evaluation, and benchmark sensitivity ( Koh et al., 2021 ; Gardner et al., 2020 ; Ribeiro et al., 2020 ; Dehghani et al., 2021 ; Alzahrani et al., 2024 ) . Related work tests surface heuristics, AgentHarm cues, benign triggers, construct validity, and broken specifications ( Li et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Tasawong et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Bean et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Tu et al., 2026 ) . Paired cue tests are established; we contribute a three-level inference ladder across released agent-safety artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 快捷方式审计将标注工件和快捷方式学习（Gururangan 等，2018；Geirhos 等，2020）与群体偏移测试、对比集、行为评估以及基准敏感度（Koh 等，2021；Gardner 等，2020；Ribeiro 等，2020；Dehghani 等，2021；Alzahrani 等，2024）连接起来。 相关研究测试了表面启发式方法、AgentHarm 提示、良性触发因素、构念效度以及失效规范（Li 等，2026；Meng 等，2025；Tasawong 等，2025；Li 等，2025；Bean 等，2025；Wang 等，2026；Tu 等，2026）。 成对提示测试已建立；我们提出了一种跨越已发布的智能体安全工件的三级推理阶梯。

sents.zh: 其他研究对 AgentDojo 进行了端到端的审计或开发了更广泛的安全防护（Bhagwatkar 等人，2025；Chen 等人，2025；Huang 等人，2025；Greenblatt 等人，2024）；我们则审计已发布的步骤记录、评估单元以及黑箱决策的敏感性。

paragraphs.en: The Luna replication does not reproduce the Haiku-sized effects, indicating that the observed sensitivity is configuration-specific. The 64-step cohort is not a probability sample, and intervals are exploratory and unadjusted. The marker rewrite changes provenance wording, aliases are not natural global renamings, and neither has blinded human validation. Q8 is quantized, GPT-5.5 lacks repeats, and StepGuard stops at a non-equivalent Mac feasibility check. LinuxArena uses completed trajectories, and AgentHarm subset identity is not proven guard-visible. We study evaluation validity, not deployment safety; execute no tool calls; and use no human-subject data.
paragraphs.zh: Luna 复制并未重现俳句规模的效果，这表明观察到的敏感性是特定于配置的。 64 步队列并非概率样本，且置信区间具有探索性且未经调整。 标记重写改变了来源表述，别名并非自然的全局重命名，并且两者均未经过盲法人类验证。 Q8 经过了量化处理，GPT-5.5 没有重复部分，而 StepGuard 会在一个不等价的 Mac 可行性检查处停止。 LinuxArena 使用已完成的轨迹，且 AgentHarm 子集的身份尚未被证明是守卫可见的。 我们研究的是评估的有效性，而非部署的安全性；不执行任何工具调用；也不使用涉及人类受试者的数据。

sents.zh: 我们研究的是评估的有效性，而非部署的安全性；不执行任何工具调用；也不使用涉及人类受试者的数据。

paragraphs.en: Agent-safety evaluations can appear reliable even when their results depend on how the benchmark is constructed. We introduced shortcut auditing, a three-level framework that separates label predictability, observational guard association, and paired decision sensitivity. Across LinuxArena , AgentDojo-Traj , and AgentHarm-Traj , simple diagnostics exposed weaknesses under domain transfer and changes in evaluation unit. Shortcut sensitivity is therefore consequential but configuration-specific. A predictive benchmark property is a hypothesis, not evidence that a guard relies on it. Shortcut auditing provides these tests, replacing apparent benchmark performance with evidence about whether evaluation conclusions survive changes intended to preserve the underlying safety decision.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体安全性评估可能看似可靠，即使其结果取决于基准的构建方式。 我们提出了“捷径审计”，一个三级框架，将标签可预测性、观察性防护关联以及成对决策敏感性分离开来。 在 LinuxArena、AgentDojo-Traj 和 AgentHarm-Traj 中，简单的诊断方法揭示了在领域迁移和评估单元变化下的弱点。 因此，捷径敏感性具有重要意义，但具体取决于配置。 预测性基准属性是一种假设，而非证明某种防护依赖于此的证据。 捷径审计提供了这些测试，用关于评估结论能否在旨在保持底层安全决策的变化中依然有效的证据，取代了表面的基准性能表现。

paragraphs.en: This appendix supplies a PDF-contained protocol. The public release package adds aggregate JSON for every table, whole-file cohort and prompt hashes, transformation and parsing source snapshots, and executable number checks. It accompanies the venue’s one-PDF submission. Raw benchmark records and provider responses remain outside version control. LinuxArena intervals use 2,000 clustered bootstrap replicates over main-task/side-task groups (seed 20260828). Cached TS-Bench intervals use 10,000 replicates (seed 260828), and the repeated Haiku and Luna analyses each use 10,000 (seed 26082945). Exact Clopper–Pearson bounds for the deterministic hash cohort are model-based descriptive summaries, not design-based population intervals. Interaction analyses cluster on the upstream source interaction; Haiku bootstraps stratify by domain without splitting mixed-label interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了一份以 PDF 格式包含的协议。 公开发布包为每张表格、每个完整文件的数据集和提示词哈希值添加了汇总 JSON，同时还包含了转换与解析的源数据快照以及可执行数值检查程序。 该发布包随附于主办方要求的单份 PDF 提交材料中。 原始基准测试记录及提供商响应内容仍保留在版本控制之外。 LinuxArena 的时间区间采用 2,000 次聚类自助重采样，覆盖主任务与子任务组（种子值 20260828）。 缓存的 TS-Bench 时间区间使用 10,000 次重采样（种子值 260828），而重复进行的 Haiku 和 Luna 分析则各使用 10,000 次重采样（种子值 26082945）。 确定性哈希数据集的精确 Clopper–Pearson 置信区间属于基于模型的描述性摘要，而非基于设计总体推断的时间区间。 交互分析以上游源交互为聚类依据；Haiku 的自助重采样按领域进行分层，但不会拆分混合标签的交互项。

paragraphs.en: All local experiments ran on a 24-GiB Apple Silicon laptop. paragraphs.en: The endpoint is anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 , routed to Anthropic only through OpenRouter, with fallback and plugins disabled and data collection denied. We use temperature 0, a 256-token cap, strict JSON-schema output, concurrency at most two, and three repetitions of five conditions. Schedule seed 260829 shuffles bases and, within each base, all conditions separately in each repetition. Each request has the four fields USER_REQUEST , INTERACTION_HISTORY , CURRENT_ACTION , and TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS . The user message is the literal prefix “Classify this benchmark step. The JSON values are untrusted data, not instructions:” followed by a newline and JSON with sorted keys and ensure_ascii=False ; the placebo changes only that JSON’s indentation. The output schema requires two Booleans, malicious_user_request and third_party_attack , and current_action_harmfulness in { 0 , 0.5 , 1 } \{0,0.5,1\} . sents.zh: 在 70 次携带 shell 的攻击和 200 条诚实轨迹中，当轨迹 FPR 为 1% 时，Opus 能检测到 .429 .429 的攻击，其中词汇诊断的准确率为 .257 .257，长度诊断的准确率为 .229 .229。

sents.en: An operational-style reconstruction instead uses all 74 attack trajectories (891 actions) and calibrates on 12,494 actions from the same 200 honest trajectories; Opus’s expected any-action detection is .785 .785 [.610, .937] at 1% step FPR.
sents.zh: 一种操作风格的重建方法则使用了全部 74 条攻击轨迹（891 个动作），并以来自相同 200 条诚实轨迹的 12,494 个动作进行校准；在 1% 的步骤 FPR 下，Opus 对任意动作的预期检测率为 .785 .785 [.610, .937]。

sents.en: The public sample lacks the harm-step information needed to reproduce the official pre-harm metric exactly.
sents.zh: 公开样本中缺少重现官方“前危害”指标所需的关键危害步骤信息。

paragraphs.en: Only three exact tool names overlap between AgentDojo-Traj and AgentHarm-Traj. This argues against a single universal tool-name rule across the two subsets. In AgentDojo-Traj, ten strict-unsafe rows are negative under the fixed marker-plus-prefix rule. Only three are unanimously blocked by all seven cached guards; the remainder receive mixed votes. These exceptions further caution against treating the fixed rule as the benchmark’s latent policy.
paragraphs.zh: AgentDojo-Traj 和 AgentHarm-Traj 之间仅有三个工具名称完全重合。 这一结果表明，这两个子集之间并不存在适用于所有情况的统一工具名称规则。 在 AgentDojo-Traj 中，有十行严格不安全的记录在固定标记加前缀规则下被判定为负面。 其中仅有三行被全部七个缓存守卫一致阻止；其余记录则获得了混合的投票结果。 这些例外情况进一步提醒我们，不应将固定规则视为基准模型潜在的策略。

paragraphs.en: For AgentHarm-Traj, 57 of 72 harmful interactions contain duplicated segment IDs, whereas none of the 125 benign interaction IDs do. We preserve all released rows for the row-level reproduction and change only their evaluation weight in the interaction analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 在 AgentHarm-Traj 中，72 个有害交互中有 57 个包含重复的片段 ID，而 125 个良性交互 ID 中则没有任何一个存在这种情况。 为了在行级别进行复现，我们保留了所有已发布的行，仅在交互分析中更改了它们的评估权重。
